body:
## Pull request overview

This PR enhances the ConfigPanel system with protocol alignment, conditional field disabling, external collapse control, and user-facing hints for navigation-dependent fields. It addresses 4 of 6 issues raised in #804, focusing on spec alignment and UX improvements.

**Changes:**
- Added `description` field to `NamedListView` protocol interface for spec alignment
- Implemented `disabledWhen` predicate on `ConfigField` to conditionally disable fields based on draft state
- Added `expandedSections` prop to `ConfigPanelRenderer` for programmatic section expansion control
- Refactored `ConfigFieldRenderer` to support `helpText` rendering for all field types and unified `disabledWhen` evaluation
- Added contextual hints for navigation-dependent fields with translations across all 10 locales

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 19 out of 19 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Added optional `description` field to NamedListView interface for protocol spec alignment |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts | Added `navigationWidthHint` and `openNewTabHint` translation keys across all 10 locale files |
| packages/components/src/types/config-panel.ts | Added `disabledWhen` predicate to ConfigField interface for conditional field disabling |
| packages/components/src/custom/config-panel-renderer.tsx | Added `expandedSections` prop for external section collapse control with proper precedence over local state |
| packages/components/src/custom/config-field-renderer.tsx | Refactored switch cases to break pattern, implemented universal `disabledWhen` evaluation and `helpText` rendering wrapper |
| packages/components/src/__tests__/config-panel-renderer.test.tsx | Added 5 new tests covering expandedSections override and disabledWhen evaluation |
| packages/components/src/__tests__/config-field-renderer.test.tsx | Added 3 new tests verifying helpText rendering for standard and custom field types |
| apps/console/src/utils/view-config-schema.tsx | Applied disabledWhen predicates to grid-only fields, added helpText to navigation fields, updated buildSwitchField signature, corrected description field comment |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/view-config-schema.test.tsx | Added 19 new tests covering grid-only disabledWhen predicates, helpText validation, and description spec alignment |
| ROADMAP.md | Updated Phase 5 documentation with new features and test counts |
</details>

The PR description mentions "all 11 locales" but the codebase actually has 10 built-in locales (en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar). All 10 locales have been correctly updated with the new translation keys `navigationWidthHint` and `openNewTabHint`.
